new.n: Train carriage herring on black bread
new.note: Pickled herring on buttered rye with red onion and dill, a cold bite for the siding.
new.how: Butter 8 slices of dark rye bread and cut each in half. Lay a piece of pickled herring on each with thin red onion rings and dill. Grind over black pepper and serve cold.

r2.make_ahead: Slice the onion and pick the dill up to 2 hours ahead; build just before serving

steps.text: Butter the rye and cut each slice in half.
Top with herring, onion rings and dill, grind over pepper and serve cold.

new.veg: Buttered rye with pickled beetroot, red onion and dill instead of herring.

new.n: Kremlin chicken Kiev with buttered peas
new.note: Crumbed chicken breast round a core of garlic butter, with buttered peas, cut at the table.
new.how: Mash 100g soft butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves and chopped parsley, roll into a log and freeze 20 minutes. Butterfly 4 chicken breasts, pound thin, wrap each round a quarter of the butter and chill. Dip in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs twice, fry until golden then bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Serve with buttered peas.

r2.make_ahead: Make the garlic butter up to 3 days ahead; crumb the chicken up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled

steps.text: Mash the butter with garlic and parsley, roll into a log and freeze, 20 min.
Butterfly and pound the chicken thin, wrap each round a quarter of the butter and chill.
Dip in flour, egg and crumbs twice.
Fry until golden, then bake at 200C, 15 min.
Cook the peas and toss with butter. Serve with the chicken.

new.veg: Crumbed mushroom and gruyère Kiev with the same garlic butter and buttered peas.

new.n: Siding syrniki with sour cream and jam
new.note: Golden cottage cheese pancakes with sour cream and cherry jam, still warm from the pan.
new.how: Mix 500g cottage cheese with 2 eggs, 3 tbsp sugar, a pinch of salt and 100g plain flour. Shape into 12 small thick rounds in more flour. Fry in butter over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. Serve warm with sour cream and cherry jam.

r2.make_ahead: Mix the batter up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; fry to serve

steps.text: Mix the cottage cheese, eggs, sugar, salt and 100g of the flour.
Shape 12 small thick rounds in the rest of the flour.
Fry in butter until golden, 3 minutes a side, 15 min in batches.
Serve warm with sour cream and jam.

new.n: Samovar tea with lemon and jam
new.note: Strong black tea poured hot over lemon, a spoon of jam on the side to stir in.
new.how: Brew 4 tsp strong black tea leaves in 1 litre of boiling water for 4 minutes and strain. Pour into glasses with a slice of lemon in each, and serve with sugar cubes and a little dish of cherry jam to stir in.

r2.make_ahead: Slice the lemons up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Brew the tea in the boiling water, 4 min, and strain.
Pour over a lemon slice in each glass and serve with sugar and jam.

new.n: Ballroom roast salmon with herbed potatoes
new.note: Salmon roasted with lemon and dill butter, baby potatoes in herbs, plated for the ball.
new.how: Boil 800g baby potatoes until tender, then toss with butter, parsley and chives. Lay 4 salmon fillets on a lined tray, top each with a slice of lemon, dill and a knob of butter and roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Serve the salmon on the potatoes with lemon wedges.

r2.make_ahead: Boil the potatoes up to 1 day ahead; warm them in the butter and herbs to serve

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, 18 min.
Top the salmon with lemon, dill and butter and roast at 200C, 12 min.
Toss the potatoes with butter and herbs and serve under the salmon.

new.veg: Roast cauliflower steaks with the same lemon and dill butter and herbed potatoes.

id: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them (2016)

new.note: Flaky pastry loaf of mushroom, sauerkraut and dill, sliced thick at the bakery counter.
new.how: Fry 1 diced onion and 400g sliced mushrooms in butter until dry. Stir in 300g drained sauerkraut, 2 chopped hard-boiled eggs, dill and pepper and cool. Lay a sheet of puff pastry on a tray, pile the filling down the middle, cover with a second sheet, seal, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until deep golden. Slice thick.

r2.make_ahead: Make and cool the filling up to 1 day ahead; fill and bake on the day

steps.text: Fry the onion and mushrooms in butter until dry, 10 min.
Stir in the sauerkraut, egg, dill and pepper and cool.
Fill and seal between the pastry sheets and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until deep golden, 30 min.
Slice thick.

new.note: Lime, grapefruit and honey over crushed ice with soda, the dry ship's own punch.
new.how: Stir 120ml lime juice, 250ml grapefruit juice and 3 tbsp honey until the honey melts. Pour over crushed ice in 4 glasses, top with soda water and add a lime wheel.

r2.make_ahead: Mix the juices and honey up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled

steps.text: Stir the juices and honey until the honey melts.
Pour over crushed ice, top with soda and add a lime wheel.
